data.notes: October’s confirmed São Paulo calendar mixes global pop/R&B stadium dates with the city’s defining rooftop, club and electronic scenes.

events.title: BTS World Tour 'Arirang' — São Paulo
events.summary: BTS closes out the São Paulo run of the World Tour 'Arirang' at Estádio do Morumbis, with the 31 October show scheduled for 20:00.

events.title: ZAYN: The Konnakol Tour
events.summary: ZAYN brings The Konnakol Tour to São Paulo for a Saturday stadium show at Nubank Parque, with the concert scheduled for 20:00.

events.title: Mochakk Calling 2026
events.summary: Mochakk brings his Mochakk Calling party back to São Paulo, with a four-and-a-half-hour long set plus Anastazja, Marina Dias and Peroli at Mercado Pago Hall in the Pacaembu complex.

events.title: MELI MUSIC – 4ª Edição
events.summary: MELI MUSIC’s fourth edition is confirmed at Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu with Anitta, Normani, Luísa Sonza, Pedro Sampaio and Gloria Groove among the announced pop lineup.

events.title: Zig Festival 2026: 10/10
events.summary: Zig Festival’s São Paulo edition is listed at Avenida Francisco Matarazzo, 694 with a large lineup headed by Slayyyter, Rochelle Jordan, Karol Conká and Linn da Quebrada, connecting hyperpop, baile funk, pop and club music.

events.title: Mamba Negra ☆ Presidenta ☆
events.summary: Scene-defining queer underground institution Mamba Negra returns for a Halloween/election-themed edition with Donia L Jelly, EVEHIVE, Matusa, Mary D, MU540, Nãovenhasemrosto, Zaila and performers/visual artists.

events.title: Jorja Smith
events.summary: Jorja Smith plays Espaço Unimed with material from What Are the Odds, with DJ Akila opening and a program linking R&B with UK garage, grime, house, afrobeats and hip-hop references.

events.title: Under Division apr. VENDEX
events.summary: Under Division’s hard-techno warehouse night brings Vendex from Spain for an exclusive Brazil date, joined by Amanda Mussi, Anddy Williams, Cabi, DJ Gabuxo and Kharsek.

events.title: Tarja Preta presents: Phase Fatale
events.summary: Industrial techno and EBM party Tarja Preta hosts Berghain/KHIDI resident Phase Fatale for his first São Paulo appearance, alongside Magal, LILITH, Barbara Dunkel b2b br:uno and Motorflavio.

events.title: Fuego Dancehall // Centro SP
events.summary: TREVVO’s Fuego Dancehall brings a large São Paulo dancehall/reggae crowd to the Centro with Lara Sanches, Sucateiro vs Black, Deivi, Oasis Trindade and OLr08.

events.title: [M]EIO 7ª Edição: Marcal & Arthur Robert
events.summary: No-phone-policy underground techno session from [M]EIO with Brazil-to-Europe techno name Marcal and Vienna/Amsterdam artist Arthur Robert in an intimate secret-location format.

events.title: GOP TUN no Edifício Martinelli
events.summary: Gop Tun DJs take over the rooftop of Edifício Martinelli for an all-day 4x4 house and disco session from 14:00 to 22:00.

events.title: From House to Disco Club presents Fafi Abdel Nour
events.summary: Amsterdam-based Fafi Abdel Nour plays the From House to Disco Club rooftop edition at Edifício Martinelli, joined by From House to Disco, Rafa Balera and Nana Kohat.

events.title: NAVE D-EDGE SP presents Vladimir Dubyshkin
events.summary: D-EDGE’s NAVE Saturday program features Russian techno artist Vladimir Dubyshkin on Pista 1 with DJ Murphy and Spuri, plus Gabriel Evoke, Hel Mello, Milani and Delete the Pattern across the club.

events.title: Ralachão - Megafest
events.summary: Black, peripheral and LGBTQIA+ São Paulo party Ralachão stages a Megafest Halloween edition after 200+ editions, focused on funk, rap, afrobeat, dancehall, R&B and amapiano-adjacent sounds.

events.title: NAVE D-EDGE SP presents Ratier & Laguna, Neverdogs
events.summary: D-EDGE’s NAVE night lists Ratier and Neverdogs as headliners for an eight-hour club program running from 23:59 to 08:00.

events.title: Pitty
events.summary: Pitty opens the tour for her new album at Espaço Unimed in São Paulo, with a 22:30 showtime and a set centered on the new record alongside career songs.

events.title: Grade Masked Ball
events.summary: Festa Grade’s annual Halloween masked ball brings Zamurai from the US for her Brazil debut alongside Mary D, Malveck, M4lta, Cherolinne and Avante in a techno/house/Latin/funk-leaning ritual format.

events.title: BTS World Tour ARIRANG — São Paulo
events.summary: BTS opens its three-show São Paulo run at Estádio MorumBIS on October 28, 2026, as part of the World Tour ARIRANG.

events.title: BTS World Tour ARIRANG — São Paulo
events.summary: BTS continues its World Tour ARIRANG São Paulo stadium run with a confirmed Estádio MorumBIS concert on October 30, 2026.

events.title: Iron Maiden: Run For Your Lives World Tour 2026
events.summary: Iron Maiden’s 50th-anniversary Run For Your Lives World Tour lands at Allianz Parque on October 25, with Alter Bridge confirmed as the opening act.

events.title: Iron Maiden: Run For Your Lives World Tour 2026 — Extra Date
events.summary: A second São Paulo Iron Maiden date is confirmed for October 27 at Allianz Parque due to demand, with Alter Bridge opening.

events.title: Maior Encontro do Samba: Zeca Pagodinho, Alcione & Jorge Aragão
events.summary: Zeca Pagodinho, Alcione and Jorge Aragão bring O Maior Encontro do Samba to Allianz Parque on October 31, adding a major samba concert to the month’s stadium calendar.

events.title: 9ª São Paulo Oktoberfest 2026
events.summary: The 9th São Paulo Oktoberfest runs into the first weekend of October with German cultural programming, typical music shows, DJs and a Biertent main stage at Parque Ibirapuera.

events.title: EsDeeKid: The Rebel Tour
events.summary: UK underground rap artist EsDeeKid is confirmed at Audio on October 22, 2026, as part of The Rebel Tour in a 30e-promoted São Paulo date.

events.title: Ensaio Da Pipoca
events.summary: Maison Missionary’s pre-sale club night at KOMPLEXO TEMPO runs overnight into Sunday, with Anne Louise and Rafha Madrid listed and a tribal house/house music focus.
